hook: A rare mouse vanished in 1927, but researchers just found three survivors.

sections.voiceover: A rare mouse vanished in 1927, but researchers just found three survivors.
sections.visual_cue: Macro shot of a dark-furred Nilopegamys plumbeus in a damp Ethiopian forest habitat.
sections.sfx_cue: Soft, rhythmic rustling of leaves in a quiet forest environment.
b_roll: Historical black and white photo of a 1927 expedition site in Ethiopia

sections.voiceover: In October 2026, an Ethiopian-Czech team explored the Yayu biosphere reserve to search for this lost creature. Where were these animals hiding?
sections.visual_cue: Map showing the Yayu biosphere reserve in southwestern Ethiopia with a research team icon.
sections.sfx_cue: Sound of rushing water in a stream, fading into ambient forest sounds.
b_roll: Wide shot of the Yayu biosphere reserve dense vegetation
Close-up of a research team collecting water samples

sections.voiceover: Except these animals appeared 350 kilometers away from the original 1927 record location.
sections.visual_cue: Animated line on a map connecting the 1927 site to the current 2026 Yayu site.
sections.sfx_cue: A subtle, high-pitched ping sound indicating a map location marker.
b_roll: Digital map showing 350 kilometers distance between two points

sections.voiceover: The team confirmed the find by identifying three Nilopegamys plumbeus specimens. This confirms the genus still exists in southwestern Ethiopia today.
sections.visual_cue: Close-up of the mouse's distinct physical features, such as its specialized tail and fur.
sections.sfx_cue: Soft, natural ambient forest sounds with a faint wind rustle.
b_roll: Scientist examining a specimen with a magnifying glass
Scientific illustration of Nilopegamys plumbeus anatomy

sections.voiceover: The Ethiopian water mouse remains protected within the Yayu biosphere reserve.
sections.visual_cue: Slow zoom out from a small stream in the Yayu reserve to show the dense forest canopy.
sections.sfx_cue: Distanced bird calls fading into silence.
b_roll: Lush, green landscape of the Yayu biosphere reserve
